'''Ashe''' was a member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] stationed on [[Rafft]]. He was a [[Technician/Legends|mechanic]] stationed in a township two hundred [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] from the Rebel base on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].
